name: Bulk Image Resizer
description: Resize many images at once by target dimensions, scale or target file size, then download them all as a ZIP.

howto: Choose what to resize by: dimensions, scale factor, or target file size.
Enter the target values for the chosen mode.
Drop one or more images (or a folder) onto the dropzone.
The tool resizes each image, keeping aspect ratio by default.
Click Download resized images to get everything in a ZIP.
features: Resize by max dimensions, scale percentage, or target file size
Batch processing with a progress log
All results bundled into a single ZIP

faq.a: No. Images are processed on a canvas entirely in your browser and only the results are downloaded.

faq.q: How does target file size work?
faq.a: The tool re-encodes the image with progressively lower JPEG quality until the size is under your target. It is a best-effort approach — very large originals may not always hit an exact size.
Yes, PNG resizes keep the alpha channel. If you resize to a target file size, the image is re-encoded as JPEG, which removes transparency.
The output keeps the original format (JPG stays JPG, PNG stays PNG). For format conversion, use the Image Format Converter tool.
